Alger, 6 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L: Algiers, October 6, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid-Ali Zerrouki, and his Nigerien counterpart, Hamani Kargné, inaugurated on Tuesday in Assamaka the operation of the Trans-Saharan fiber-optic backbone connecting Algeria to Niger.
Mise en service d'une infrastructure de: Commissioning of a strategic cross-border telecommunications infrastructure
La cérémonie marquant le début de l'expl: The ceremony marking the start of operations for this digital link was held at the Algerian-Nigerien border, in the presence of various dignitaries, including the Algerian ambassador to Niger and the governor of Agadez. Carried out by the technical teams of Algérie-Télécom and Niger-Télécom, this project connects In-Guezzam, in Algeria, to the Arlit-Agadez region, in Niger.
Dotée d'équipements de transmission mode: Equipped with modern transmission equipment, the infrastructure provides an initial capacity of one hundred gigabits per second right from its launch. This technical configuration aims to efficiently process cross-border data flows and meet the growing demand for connectivity. Furthermore, the system incorporates high modularity, allowing for the gradual increase of data rates according to the future requirements of both nations.
Un levier pour l'intégration numérique e: A lever for digital integration and the Sahel economy
Intervenant lors de l'évènement, le mini: Speaking at the event, the Minister of Post and Telecommunications recalled that this initiative is part of the work of the Liaison Committee bringing together six African states, namely Algeria, Mali, Niger, Mauritania, Nigeria, and Chad. The project draws its foundations from the New Partnership for Africa's Development (NEPAD) initiative.
Cette interconnexion vise à stimuler l'é: This interconnection aims to stimulate the Sahel's digital economy by optimizing broadband access, supporting the digital transition, and boosting economic exchanges as well as online public services. The infrastructure also aims to consolidate the digital sovereignty of the continent's states.
Inauguration officielle de la dorsale tr: Official inauguration of the Trans-Saharan fiber-optic backbone in Assamaka by Sid-Ali Zerrouki and Hamani Kargné.
Tracé reliant la localité algérienne d'I: Route connecting the Algerian locality of In-Guezzam to the Nigerien zone of Arlit-Agadez.
Capacité de transmission initiale établi: Initial transmission capacity established at one hundred gigabits per second.
Réalisation assurée par les équipes d'Al: Implementation carried out by the teams of Algérie-Télécom and Niger-Télécom.
Projet rattaché au Comité de liaison de: Project linked to the Trans-Saharan Backbone Liaison Committee and inspired by NEPAD.
Objectifs affichés incluant l'élargissem: Stated objectives include expanding high-speed internet access and strengthening digital sovereignty.
